verdict.rationale: Postmark exposes a comprehensive documented REST API (email sending, batch/template sending, bounce management, message search, stats, webhooks, templates, domains, servers, inbound parsing) with official SDKs and clear authentication scheme, plus community confirmation of straightforward curl/POST usage without needing a client library. Missing for 10: no discoverable OpenAPI/Swagger spec (probe found 404s) and no independent third-party audit of full API coverage beyond docs.
